actions.runHint: Runs on {{subject}}. Running it again with the same request is safe: the server returns the first result.
actions.inputHint: Optional. The values the action needs.
actions.replayed: This action had already run for this request; the first result is shown.
actions.targetHint: BPMN: the process key to start. REST: a path on this server.

cf.title: Custom fields
cf.desc: Extra fields a tenant adds to its forms. Each field has dated versions; a retired field keeps its stored values.
cf.keyHint: x_ followed by lower-case letters, digits or _, for example x_ward_no.
cf.label: Label
cf.defineHint: Types: string (formats decimal, integer-string, date, date-time, email), integer, boolean, array. A decimal is {"type": "string", "format": "decimal"}. A field cannot be both required and read only.
cf.retireHint: From this date the field is no longer asked for. Values already stored stay readable.

fld.dependsOn: Depends on (JSON list of milestone ids)

committees.ackHint: The notice id is in the answer of Send notices.

common.reasonAsciiOnly: This reason travels in a request header, which carries plain ASCII text only. Write it with ASCII letters, digits and punctuation.

links.title: Links
links.desc: Links between processes, cases and tasks.

registry.expireHint: Ends the instrument's validity now, as the expiry sweep would.
registry.reissueHint: Issues a new instrument to the new holder and closes this one.
registry.revealHint: Shows the full identifier once. Your purpose and the reveal are recorded in the audit trail, and the holder's consent is checked.

onb.guidedHint: Fill in the steps; leave a field empty to use the server's default. Review shows the request, dry-runs it and starts the run.
onb.fixFirst: Some steps have problems. Fix them before the dry run.

err.object: Enter a JSON object, for example {"key": "value"}.
err.array: Enter a JSON list, for example [ ].

compliance.jurisdictions: Compliance jurisdictions (comma-separated, first is the tenant's)

f.dmnOverrides: Decision overrides (JSON: decision key to DMN XML)

tenant.id: Letters, digits, . _ -; a child tenant is written A.B.

security.orgLevels: Empty means the profile's default hierarchy. Levels are fixed once the first office exists.

packs.title: Packs
packs.desc: Packs installed for a tenant: roll back to the previous version or uninstall. Platform administrators only; every change is audited with its reason.
packs.none: No packs are installed for this tenant.
packs.rollbackHint: The previous version is deployed again as a new patch version. Running instances keep their version.
packs.uninstallHint: Removes every version of the pack from the tenant. Refused while instances run or another pack depends on it.

reason.PACK_NOT_INSTALLED: This pack is not installed for this tenant.
reason.PACK_HAS_DEPENDANTS: Other installed packs depend on this pack. Uninstall them first:
reason.PACK_HAS_LIVE_INSTANCES: Process or case instances of this pack are still running:
reason.PACK_NO_PREVIOUS_VERSION: Only one version is installed, so there is nothing to roll back to.
reason.PACK_VERSION_NOT_SEMVER: An installed version is not MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, so the next version cannot be computed:
reason.PACK_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: Another deploy, roll-back or uninstall of this pack is running for this tenant. Try again shortly.
reason.PACK_REJECTED: The previous version no longer passes the model checks:

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.policyHint: The policy the public sees, built from the active purposes, the activity register and the published contacts. Change those to change it.
privacy.fallback: Not available in the requested language; shown in the tenant's default language.
privacy.publicDesc: How your personal data is used and how to exercise your rights.

promo.title: Promotions
promo.exportHint: Downloads the tenant's signed configuration bundle from this environment.
promo.planHint: Load a bundle exported from another environment. The server checks its signature and shows what would change here.
promo.unsignedAccepted: Unsigned bundle, accepted only because this server allows unsigned bundles (development).
promo.applied: Run {{id}} started ({{status}}). A different administrator approves it under Runs.

err.PROMOTION_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_SET: This server has no environment label, so it cannot export or receive a promotion.
err.PROMOTION_ENVIRONMENT_MISSING: The bundle does not name its source environment. Export it again from a server with an environment label.
err.PROMOTION_SAME_ENVIRONMENT: The bundle comes from this environment. Promote it to a different one.
err.PROMOTION_TARGET_MISMATCH: The target tenant's current configuration belongs to another tenant.
err.PROMOTION_PLAN_CHANGED: The target or the bundle changed since this plan was made. Plan again and review.
err.PROMOTION_DRY_RUN_FAILED: The dry run of this plan has errors. Fix them before applying.
err.PROMOTION_NO_CHANGE: The target already has this configuration.
err.BUNDLE_INVALID: This is not a tenant bundle.
err.BUNDLE_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The bundle's signature does not verify against a trusted key.
err.BUNDLE_UNSIGNED: Unsigned bundles are refused outside development.
err.BUNDLE_SIGNER_MISSING: No bundle signing key is configured on this server.

secdef.title: Security defaults
secdef.desc: Installs the module role templates for your tenant. Installing again is safe.
secdef.selfServiceHint: Also install the grants that let people act on their own records.

tests.casesFromReport: Use these cases for the export
tests.exportHint: Exports test cases and mock rules with a SHA-256 seal, to run them on another environment.
tests.cases: Test cases (JSON list of {id, processKey, definition})
tests.verified: The seal is intact: package {{pkg}}, revision {{rev}}.

tpl.saveHint: JSON content is the template document: {"appliesTo": ["bpmn:ServiceTask"], "fields": [{"name", "binding", "required", "pattern", "default", "choices"}]}.
tpl.tryApplyHint: Checks values against the template on the server and shows the properties it would write.
tpl.manual: These bindings need Operaton extension elements, which the editor does not write. Add them in the XML:

err.pattern: Does not match the template's pattern.
err.choices: Not one of the allowed values.
